Babita calls Jethalal asking him to keep an eye on Iyer while she visits the clinic. Jethalal eagerly brings over special tea, followed by the rest of the neighbors dropping by with well wishes, books, and hot dhoklas to comfort an injured Iyer.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
